capabilities: Log transactions as tags in daily notes via URL capture, GitHub gist, inbox files or quick add
Track pace-aware budgets and recurring bills from a markdown table and bill notes
Manage savings goals, trips and split expenses with sinking-fund maths
Track share portfolio, account balances and net worth with optional price feeds
Render dashboard, review, forecast and query blocks in any note
extras: Deliberately no bank connections, receipt OCR or telemetry by design; Android capture paths are reasoned from documentation but untested by the author; MIT licensed with a Buy Me a Coffee donation link; documentation of limitations and migration steps included in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record spending in daily notes or turn plain-text transaction bullets into budgets, bills, goals and financial dashboards.

relations.evidence: @date (ISO, yesterday, weekday, or anything the Natural Language Dates plugin parses)
detected from the Journals community plugin or the core Daily notes plugin when present

requires.name: GitHub account and fine-grained token (gist capture only)

summary: Personal finance tracker that logs spending as tags in daily notes and builds pace-aware budgets, bills, goals, trips, portfolio and forecast dashboards from them.
